title: Exploring the dynamic interplay of cognitive load and emotional arousal by using multimodal measurements: Correlation of pupil diameter and emotional arousal in emotionally engaging tasks
reasoning: The study's core methodology involves participants engaging with 'everyday moral dilemmas' which are explicitly described as tasks containing 'moral conflict' and involving 'moral judgment' to elicit emotional and cognitive responses. This makes the evaluation of morals and ethics a central component of the paper's experimental design.
